title: Chapter 33
text: 3 A German word, slang for “wimp,” that literally means “a man who sits to pee.” Those wacky Germans—they’ve got a word for everything. 4 “Kafir” is a not-nice Arabic word meaning “non-Muslim” that is usually translated as “infidel.” 5 The Islamic statement of faith, in transliterated Arabic: there is no God but God.
